subject: Redwood pricing deck & estimate
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Iqbal <samir.iqbal@acme.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood pricing deck & estimate

Hi Samir / Olivia,

Great speaking with you earlier — thanks for walking through Acme's priority use cases and forecasted usage. As discussed, I attached a concise estimate and a recommended configuration that aligns with your latency and throughput targets. Quick recap: 

- Primary goal: real-time recommendations for web product (99th-p95 latency target ~200ms)
- Expected volume: ~6M generated tokens/month (peak bursts during 9–11am PT)
- Recommended setup: Dedicated pool (2 x A100 equiv.), prefix caching, and medium quantization profile

Attached: Redwood-Estimate-Acme-20261208.pdf (estimate + optional add-ons). Highlights in the deck: pricing tiers, SLA options, and a one-page deployment timeline.

Next steps / ask:
- Can we schedule a 30-min walkthrough early next week to go over the assumptions and adjust any line items? (Here’s my calendar: https://calendly.com/ben-carter/30min)
- If you want, I can include a short appendix on security & compliance items for your InfoSec and procurement teams.

If you didn't receive the attachment or want a different format (Sheets/CSV), say the word and I’ll resend.

Best,

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: Redwood-Estimate-Acme-20261208.pdf (application/pdf, 82KB)

Subject: Re: Redwood pricing deck & estimate

Hi Samir / Olivia —

Just wanted to follow up on the estimate I sent last week (see quoted below). Did you get a chance to review the numbers? Happy to walk through line-by-line — I can tailor the estimate if your expected token volume or SLA needs differ.

If it helps, here are two quick options we often recommend for teams your size:
- Option A (predictable): Reserved Dedicated pool + 99.9% SLA — best for steady production load
- Option B (flexible): Mix of hosted + burst Dedicated capacity — lowers commitment while handling peaks

My calendar again: https://calendly.com/ben-carter/30min — if none of those times work, tell me a few windows and I’ll coordinate.

Thanks,
Ben
